title: nan
authors: Onishi Y.; Murakami H.; Nakamura M.; Hashizume H.; Sugimoto M.
key_contribution: Proposes ReFDrone, a visible-light 4DoF indoor drone localization system for GNSS-denied environments using rolling-shutter AoA, with extensive experimental evaluation.
problem_solved: Addressing state estimation drift in GNSS-denied navigation.
methodology_summary: Fuses sensor data using Filter_Based_VIO to ensure precise positioning.
